title: Concept: Impersonated session recorded in the response
description: A session that names the staff member who is impersonating the customer in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: An impersonation path exists in the product, and the response names the actor and the customer, which is a high-value target pair if it leaks beyond staff.
applicability: Deployments that render a session that names the staff member who is impersonating the customer into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: An impersonation path exists in the product, and the response names the actor and the customer, which is a high-value target pair if it leaks beyond staff.
